case_revisions: After the first run, cpri-li-1900 and workbook 2600 kV were found to exceed the crest the circuit can reach within the stage-voltage rating; their expected outcome was corrected to rejection and feasible high-voltage cases (CPRI 1650 kV, workbook 2250 kV) were added. No model, search or limit was changed.

error_definitions.waveform_nrmse_pct: sqrt(mean((displayed − independent)²)) / independent crest over 0–2·t50 at 600 points.
